summary: 仕様・設計文書にfrontmatter等で status/version/対象system version/作成日/出典/owner/再確認trigger を付け、失効文書はsupersededとして削除または隔離する。

evidence.summary: reason・owner・対象version・失敗例・review triggerをfrontmatter/inventoryで持つ。candidate/medium。'metadataだけ更新する形骸化'が失敗条件。
'Delete Dead Documentation': 陳腐化docは開発者を誤導し保守放置の前例を作るので体系的に削除。'Update Docs with Code': codeと同じCLで更新。
ADRはstatus(proposed/accepted/superseded)を持ち、過去決定は編集せず新ADRでsupersedeし決定logを保つ。
Spec Kit clarifyは'### Session YYYY-MM-DD'で日付付きに記録し、矛盾する旧記述は'replaced, not duplicated'。

canonize-mark (public, reputation unknown): read SKILL.md on skills.sh: inventory-and-classify pass that normalizes durable intent, reconciles active constraints and marks planning sediment in place so its status is unmistakable.

applies_when: 設計書・PRD・ADR・AI週報などを複数世代保持する
AIが古い文書を検索して読む可能性がある(A06)

expected_effect.primary: AIと人間が文書の鮮度・適用範囲・出典を判定でき、古い仕様の採用を防ぐ
metrics: 古い設計書起因の誤実装件数

cost: template/frontmatter追加は数分。既存文書へのbackfillは文書数に比例
known_failure_modes: metadata追加のみで削除・隔離をしない(A06は残る)
statusを持ちながらAgentに読ませる際にstatusをfilterしない
日付だけで対象system versionがない(どのschema/APIに対する仕様か不明)

existing_asset.confirmed_by: read SKILL.md on skills.sh: inventory-and-classify pass that normalizes durable intent, reconciles active constraints and marks planning sediment in place so its status is unmistakable.
matched_on: inventory and classify every document as canonical or superseded
mark status in place so agents can tell trusted spec from stale planning material
let code/config/schemas/tests own mechanically discoverable truth

alternates.why_not_primary: established (Elastic org) and implements the frontmatter-audit mechanism across a docs directory, but its required field set is Elastic-specific, not status/version/target-version/owner/revalidation-trigger

evidence: https://github.com/elastic/elastic-docs-skills (71 stars, 10 forks, last commit 2026-08-13; maintained by the Elastic org)

alternates.why_not_primary: established status lifecycle, but for ADRs only and without version/date/owner metadata

evidence: https://skills.sh/addyosmani/agent-skills/documentation-and-adrs (22.8K installs; Trust Hub Pass / Socket Pass / Snyk Pass)
SKILL.md read: ADR Lifecycle PROPOSED -> ACCEPTED -> (SUPERSEDED or DEPRECATED), 'don't delete old ADRs', 'match the existing convention first / surface the conflict'

alternates.why_not_primary: drift detection without lifecycle metadata; 24-star dormant repo
